entries.subject: Radius, mass, temperature and placement
entries.finding: Radius 0.6489 solar radii, mass 0.6897 solar masses, effective temperature 4450 +/- 150 K and barycentre radial velocity -32.769 km/s from Doyle et al. (2011), Table 1. Position, parallax 13.2806 +/- 0.0284 mas and proper motion from Gaia EDR3 via SIMBAD; Gaia sees the unresolved pair, whose photocentre is star A to well under a milliarcsecond.

entries.subject: SOPHIE dynamical masses of A and B
entries.finding: Sebastian et al. (2025, EBLM XV) measure dynamical masses 2 to 7% above earlier values. Not adopted: the orbit elements this system is drawn with were fitted jointly with Doyle et al.'s masses, and mixing the two would move the barycentre without a matching orbit fit.

entries.subject: A measured temperature for star B
entries.finding: None found. Bender et al. (2012) adopted 2800 K from the template star GJ 905 to cross-correlate B's spectrum, which is not a measurement of B; Doyle et al.'s supplement, which may discuss it, was not reachable (science.org refused the download). B is drawn in the shared neutral gray.

entries.subject: A resolved image of the photosphere
entries.finding: Kepler-16 A subtends 0.08 mas, far below the resolution of CHARA or VLTI; no image exists.
